'''John Towner''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Phoenix Mega Tournament (4 November)]] on 4 November 2000, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1419">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-phoenix-mega-tournament-11-4-00d1419/ phoenix-mega-tournament-11-4-00], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 5 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-phoenix-mega-tournament-11-4-00d1419/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
